name: Hex Shogi 91
author: Fergus Duniho (2000) / AGP port
description: Shogi on the 91-hex board of Gliński's Hexagonal Chess, turned 30° so the ranks run horizontally. Every piece is re-cut for six orthogonal and six diagonal directions — a 12-way king, a two-way lance, a four-way jumping knight — and captured pieces still come back as drops. There is no two-pawns-per-file rule (there are no vertical files); instead a pawn may not be dropped where a friendly pawn defends it, nor where it would give check at all. The promotion zone is four ranks deep.
